stories.title: Castell Alun named flagship school for Airbus Future Engineers Programm
stories.summary: Year 9 pupils from Castell Alun High School will design, build and flight-test their own drones at Airbus’s Broughton site, as the company brings its Future Engineers Programme to North Wales. stories.title: Emergency sewer repair under way at Chester Road East junction in Queensferry
stories.summary: Welsh Water crews are working through the night on an emergency sewer repair at the junction of Chester Road East and Station Road in Queensferry. stories.title: Mold archive centre to replace Flintshire Record Office in Hawarden approved
stories.summary: Plans for an archive centre in Mold that will replace the Flintshire Record Office in Hawarden have been approved by councillors. stories.title: Flintshire schools forecast to be £8.2m in the red next year, and the council says it could get worse
stories.summary: Flintshire’s schools are forecast to be £8.2 million in the red by next March, as the council’s audited accounts confirm schools ended last year in deficit. stories.title: CMA proposes opening up iPhone contactless payments to rival apps
stories.summary: Apple could be required to open up the iPhone’s contactless technology to rival payment apps, digital IDs and travel passes under proposals from the UK’s competition watchdog.
